fusions.name: Run Them Under
fusions.desc: You run straight through everything in a cone up to 5 tiles ahead, dealing 34 damage to each as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Kick After Kick
fusions.desc: A kick that deals 7 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of health the target still has (max +30%). Holds 5 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Unflagging
fusions.desc: Your attack speed rises 25% for 15 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Last Reserves
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
